description.text: There would be Entrance Examinations for applicants: Date: Every July for International Students Contents: Theories of TCM, TCM Comprehensive, Chinese Language, Specialty Medical Insurance: 600 RMB/Year (1,000 RMB for 45 Year-old or Elder)

duration.text: The Acupuncture and Moxibustion and Tuina at Tianjin University of Traditional Chinese Medicine is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5694 USD/per year ￥ 41000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number&expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.3.Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4.Academic transcript of high school5.Two Recommendation lettersFrom Professors, associate professors or equivalents.

requirements.text: Applicant should meet one of the following requirements:TCM Bachelor's Degree with a good command of English;Non-TCM Bachelor's or Equivalent Degree, and Bearer of TCM or Acupuncturist License in his home country;Non-TCM Bachelor's or Equivalent Degree, has been trained for TCM or Acupuncture, and been practicing them over 2 years;Non-TCM Bachelor's or Equivalent Degree, and has completed the designated courses.
